summary: Iter 94 — End-to-end frontend validation of the 5 new Auditor Room / Defensibility enhancements (Auditor Notes, Kill Connector runtime clause, Evidence Watermark, Room Expiry Renew, Board Evidence Digest) against the LIVE owner org. ALL FLOWS PASS. Baseline restored after run: AGT-001 sanctioned, all created auditor rooms revoked, evidence-rooms list empty.

design_issues.screen: Agent Inventory → deep-dive-modal → Suspend result banner
issues: Cosmetic: the standard-action-result banner concatenates the base message ('… suspended — enforced in the control plane.') and then the runtime clause ('· enforced in the control plane'), so the phrase 'enforced in the control plane' appears twice back-to-back. Functionally correct; consider stripping the duplicated clause when action.result already contains 'control plane' or 'runtime'.

action_items: (Nit) De-duplicate the runtime clause in standard-action-result when the base message already includes 'enforced in the control plane' — otherwise it prints twice on Suspend/Resume for AGT-001 (no webhook configured).
critical_code_review_comments: AuditorQuestionsCard reply input uses data-testid `auditor-question-reply-input-<id>` while the spec description in the request calls it `reply-text` — spec is inconsistent with code. Code (input) is fine; consider updating request/docs.
GET /api/agents/runtime/evidence-room-comments returns {comments:[…]} but the natural naming would be `items` for consistency with other list endpoints. Non-blocking.

Sonner toasts are dismissed quickly and rendered via a portal at document.body — automated harness observers occasionally miss them; UI functionality itself is correct (verified via live API responses).
test_credentials: jblan2026@gmail.com / Obserra2026! (cookie auth) — form-based login was flaky in the harness; login was performed via fetch('/api/auth/login', {credentials:'include'}) which set the httpOnly access_token/refresh_token cookies reliably.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 auditor room (token YARTCctFj90ya4oo0OIRzw) and 1 auditor question (id in1Da9q9wyfu) during the run. Both cleaned up: room revoked (POST /api/agents/runtime/evidence-room/revoke → {revoked:true}); question resolved with governance reply. AGT-001 suspended once then restored via POST /api/actions/run {action_id:'agent_resume:AGT-001'} → status back to `sanctioned`. Final evidence-rooms list = []; AGT-001 = sanctioned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified end-to-end this run: (1) POST /api/auth/login sets Partitioned httpOnly cookies — form-based Playwright submit sometimes drops the cookie in the harness; the reliable pattern is `await page.evaluate(async()=>fetch('/api/auth/login',{method:'POST',credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({email,password})}))`. (2) Defensibility tab has: agentic-auditor-room card (Create/Email board digest buttons + list with Renew/Copy/Revoke per row) and agentic-auditor-questions inbox (auditor-questions-list; per-question card auditor-question-<id> with auditor-question-reply-btn-<id> → auditor-question-reply-input-<id> + auditor-question-reply-send-<id>). Reply textarea testid is `reply-input` NOT `reply-text`. (3) Create room → auditor-room-latest / auditor-room-latest-url input contains https URL; row auditor-room-<token> lists Renew/Copy/Revoke. Renew UI = POST /api/agents/runtime/evidence-room/renew → 200 {expires_at,...}; toast 'Renewed — now expires …' appears (sonner portal). (4) Email board digest → POST /api/agents/runtime/board-evidence-digest/send returned {sent:1} → toast 'Board evidence digest emailed to 1 recipient(s) with the signed PDF.'. (5) Public /audit-room/<token> (unauth confirmed: /api/auth/me returns 401): audit-room, audit-room-counts, audit-room-agents, audit-room-trail, audit-room-download (href = /api/agents/public/evidence-room/<token>/pack.pdf?who=<name>), audit-room-dl-name (typing updates ?who= live), audit-room-questions with audit-room-q-name/email/text + audit-room-q-submit → audit-room-question-sent 'Thanks — your question was sent…'. Public GET evidence-room-comments HIDES author_email (verified: 'jane.auditor@example.com' NOT in DOM even though it was in the admin API response). (6) After admin reply the audit-room-thread shows the question as Resolved with the governance reply text. (7) /audit-room/bogus… → audit-room-error 'Auditor room unavailable'. (8) After Revoke the row disappears and the same public URL now returns audit-room-error. (9) Standard-action-result banner for Suspend AGT-001 = '✓ AGT-001 suspended — enforced in the control plane. · enforced in the control plane · written to the audit trail + Defensibility Ledger' — runtime clause is appended (no webhook configured in this org, hence 'enforced in the control plane' rather than 'dispatched to the agent runtime ✓'). Duplicate 'control plane' phrase is cosmetic. Post-test cleanup done via API (agent_resume:AGT-001 + evidence-room/revoke). Rooms list now empty. GET /api/agents/runtime/evidence-room-comments returned 2 items (both marked Resolved after the reply flow). No functional bugs found.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all 5 requested enhancements are working end-to-end on the frontend. Only cosmetic nit is the duplicated 'enforced in the control plane' clause in the Suspend/Resume result banner when the base action message already contains that phrase and the runtime-clause appender doesn't dedupe.
